question: What proportion of insulin and C-peptide synthesize the beta cells of the islets of Langerhans?

options.opa: One molecule of insulin per C peptide
options.opb: Two molecules of insulin for each peptide C.
options.opc: One molecule of insulin for every two peptides C.
options.opd: Peptide C is synthesized in C cells
options.ope: There is a variable proportion between the synthesis of insulin and that of peptide C.
